definitions.explanation: A flexible ruler that can be rolled up, used for measuring lengths.

examples.japanese: {巻尺|まきじゃく}で{部屋|へや}の{長|なが}さを{測|はか}った。
examples.english: I measured the length of the room with a tape measure.

examples.japanese: {引越|ひっこ}しの{時|とき}、{巻尺|まきじゃく}が{必要|ひつよう}だ。
examples.english: You need a tape measure when moving.

examples.japanese: {巻尺|まきじゃく}を{伸|の}ばして{家具|かぐ}のサイズを{確認|かくにん}する。
examples.english: I extend the tape measure to check the size of the furniture.

notes:
FORMATION:
{巻|まき} (rolling/coil) + {尺|じゃく} (measure/ruler)

ALTERNATE TERMS:
・メジャー - measure (loanword, commonly used)
・コンベックス - retractable tape measure (for construction)

TYPES:
・{裁縫用|さいほうよう} - sewing tape measure (soft/flexible)
・{工事用|こうじよう} - construction tape measure (stiff/retractable)

COLLOCATIONS:
・{巻尺|まきじゃく}で{測|はか}る - to measure with a tape measure
・{巻尺|まきじゃく}を{伸|の}ばす - to extend the tape measure
・{巻尺|まきじゃく}を{巻|ま}き{戻|もど}す - to retract the tape measure
